towns.name: Freehold
towns.summary: MacNiall's Freehold (74.2S 92.3E) is the breakaway settlement of the Aluvian MacNiall 'the Unruled', whose band of escaped slaves lived for a time in Kryst before rejecting its 'outdated moral codes' and trekking deeper into the Vesayen Isles to settle a small, safe island (Town Network sign) - a bandit haven with MacNiall, his lieutenant Onda Nakoza, Jesren the Jolly Barkeep and the archmage Kaza Nijina. In the DAT the whole island (LBs 0xF222/0xF322) is a jungle plateau 18 m above narrow beaches with open sea on every side; on top stand a blue-stone chapel tower on the west cliff edge, MacNiall's hall, a spire hall, two smaller halls, the Nullified Statue of a Sclavus on its pedestal, the Life Stone and the Town Network portal pad, with seven lantern posts.
